gloss: travel stories; tales from a trip

definitions.gloss: travel stories; tales from a trip
definitions.explanation: Stories and anecdotes that someone brings back from a journey to share with others. The word treats these stories as a kind of intangible souvenir.

examples.japanese: {土産話|みやげばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土産話|みやげばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: We had a great time sharing travel stories.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧{土産話|みやげばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った→持ち帰る：04227_mochikaeru⟧。
examples.english: My friend who returned from overseas brought back many interesting travel stories.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{土産|みやげ}→土産：03746_miyage⟧ (souvenir) and {話|ばなし} (story, talk). The rendaku (sequential voicing) changes はなし to ばなし. The word treats stories and experiences from a trip as something you "bring back" to share, like a souvenir.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土産話|みやげばなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かせる→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to share travel stories (with someone)
- {土産話|みやげばなし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: to get excited sharing travel stories
- {土産話|みやげばなし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧: to chat animatedly about a trip

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅行記|りょこうき}→旅行記：22659_ryokouki⟧: travel journal, travelogue — a written account, more formal and structured
- ⟦{体験談|たいけんだん}→体験談：25618_taikendan⟧: account of personal experience — broader term, not limited to travel
